purpose: Block a candidate when its temporal visual content is identical, near-identical, or substantially contained in an already evaluated clone candidate.
notes: The gate compares decoded visual content and therefore can detect many re-encoded duplicates.
A candidate is also blocked when most of the shorter clip is perceptually contained in the longer clip and the shared duration is substantial.
Appending a few seconds to an old candidate does not create a new behavioral candidate.
A duplicate candidate must not be promoted or counted as new behavioral coverage.
